title: Hermetic screencast recipe
description: A tutorial video described as data. Rendered deterministically to mp4 by `v2sbench render`; no video bytes are ever committed. Intentionally shape-compatible with crates/extractor/eval/<id>/recipe.json in the video-to-skill repository so recipes are portable between the intrinsic and extrinsic evaluations.

stills.description: Keyed screen states. Each still holds from its `t` until the next. Every still after the first that is not `continuous` is a gold visual change.

step.description: Kebab-case step label; stills sharing a label form that step's span.

continuous.description: Part of a scroll or streaming output rather than a discrete change.

type.description: The command shown typed at the prompt. Read off pixels by the extractor; this is the ground truth a transcript cannot carry.

focus.description: Button or row drawn with focus, and where the synthetic cursor is placed.

narration.description: Spoken cues, synthesised by TTS and muxed as the audio track. Write these the way a narrator really speaks -- vague about exact syntax -- so the transcript-only arm is a fair representation of what narration alone carries.
